def min_bullets_to_kill_monsters(T, test_cases):
    results = []
    for case in test_cases:
        n, monsters = case
        bullets = 0
        for i in range(n):
            a_i, b_i = monsters[i]
            if a_i <= b_i:
                bullets += 1
            else:
                bullets += (a_i - b_i + b_i - 1) // b_i
        results.append(bullets)
    return results
